name: Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following - USDJPY
description: Trend-following strategy on USD/JPY using Ichimoku Cloud signals on daily bars. Long entry when Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen AND close is above the Kumo (above both Senkou Span A and B). Short entry when Tenkan-sen crosses below Kijun-sen AND close is below the Kumo (below both spans). Exits via 2x ATR(14) trailing stop. Position sizing: 100% of equity per trade. Standard Ichimoku parameters: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52.
source:
# Ichimoku Cloud Trend-Following Strategy on USD/JPY
# Entry: TK cross + price above/below Kumo (cloud)
# Exit: 2x ATR(14) trailing stop
# Sizing: 100% of equity per trade
# Ichimoku params: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# --- Ichimoku Kinko Hyo (standard parameters) ---
ichi = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)(high, low, close)
tenkan = ichi.tenkan      # Conversion line (9-period midpoint)
kijun = ichi.kijun        # Base line (26-period midpoint)
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a  # Cloud boundary A (forward-displaced)
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b  # Cloud boundary B (forward-displaced)

# --- Cloud position filters ---
# Close above BOTH senkou spans = above the cloud
above_cloud = close > senkou_a and close > senkou_b

# Close below BOTH senkou spans = below the cloud
below_cloud = close < senkou_a and close < senkou_b

# --- TK Cross signals (pulse) ---
tk_bull_cross = crossover(tenkan, kijun)    # Tenkan crosses above Kijun
tk_bear_cross = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)   # Tenkan crosses below Kijun

# --- Persist cross state with hold_until ---
# Hold bullish state from TK bull cross until TK bear cross fires
bull_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_bull_cross, exit=tk_bear_cross)
# Hold bearish state from TK bear cross until TK bull cross fires
bear_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_bear_cross, exit=tk_bull_cross)

# --- Entry signals: persistent state AND cloud filter ---
long_entry = bull_state and above_cloud
short_entry = bear_state and below_cloud

# --- ATR for trailing stop ---
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 2)
